infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RescueWave needs your location to raise accurate SOS alerts and find nearby hospitals, police and fire stations.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: RescueWave keeps sharing your live location with an emergency contact, Helper, or Authority while the app is in the background.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: RescueWave keeps sharing your live location with an emergency contact, or while you're responding as a Helper, even when the app is in the background.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RescueWave needs camera access to take photos — for missing-person reports, incident reports, your profile photo — and for the camera preview screen.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: RescueWave needs photo library access to attach a photo when reporting a missing person.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: RescueWave needs microphone access to record voice notes when reporting an incident.
